books.description: Tac pham kinh dien cua Nam Cao ve cuoc song nhan vat nong thon trong xa hoi phong kien. Lang leo la mot nhan vat chinh muon thoat khoi doi song lam chet tam hon, nhung cuoi cung van that bai va giac mo ve hanh phuc dan ong.

books.title: Chiec la cuoi cung
books.description: Truyen ngan chan cam cua Nam Cao, noi ve doi song gia dinh Viet Nam truoc cach mang. Nhan vat Chinh phai doi mat voi su that dau long ve gia dinh minh.

books.title: Thuyen bac nho
books.description: Tuyen tap tho hay cua Xuan Dieu, mot trong nhung tap tho dep nhat cua van hoc Vietnam. Nhung bai tho ve tinh yeu, que huong, doi song va con nguoi.

books.title: Tam Cam
books.description: Chuyen tich co tich Viet Nam, phien ban cua To Hoai. Cau chuyen tinh yeu bi tra tra ve cuoi cung chet trong bieu tuong va giac mo.

books.title: Toi thay hoa vang tren co xanh
books.description: Tieu thuyet noi tieng cua Ngo Tat Lu ve doi song nong thon Vietnam. Nhan vat Chinh trai qua doi song day bien doi voi gia dinh, tinh yeu va hy vong.

books.title: Norwegian Wood
books.description: A coming-of-age novel by Haruki Murakami. Set in late 1960s Tokyo, it follows Toru Watanabe as he navigates love, loss, and the transition to adulthood.

books.title: One Hundred Years of Solitude
books.description: Gabriel Garcia Marquez masterpiece about the Buendia family across seven generations in the mythical town of Macondo.

books.title: Cho toi xin mot ve di tuoi tho
books.description: Tieu thuyet noi tieng cua Nguyen Nhat Anh ve thanh nien trong doi song thanh thi, voi nhung su troi ngang, buon cuoi va hanh phuc.

books.title: Dac trung tam ly hoc cua nguoi Viet
books.description: Cuon sach ve tam ly hoc nguoi Viet, phan tich tam li, hanh vi va tinh cach cua nguoi Viet trong doi song hien dai.

books.title: Kafka on the Shore
books.description: Haruki Murakami novel featuring parallel narratives: a teenage boy named Nakata who can speak with cats, and an aging, Kleptomaniac Oracle named Hoshino.

books.title: Dế Mèn Phiêu Lưu Ký
books.description: Tác phẩm thiếu nhi kinh điển về hành trình trưởng thành, tình bạn và trách nhiệm.

books.title: Tư Duy Phản Biện
